surface: runtime strategy rule for demo and funded producers
authorizes: rule parameters only; venue permission comes from the separately armed Rust engine and its host credential
descends_from: nothing - a new sleeve. It consumes the carry v7 pre-settle exit fire (lane2_carry_hold_v7.json under the v7 clock) as its trigger, but its economics are its own.
claim: After a dying deep-negative funding print settles, the name keeps falling for about an hour. When carry's v7 pre-settle exit fires, take over the exact position carry abandons as a SHORT, and cover 60 minutes after the settlement. The trigger, the name, and the size are all carry's own fire - this sleeve adds no signal, no threshold, and no universe of its own.

read_this_before_citing_a_number.the_mechanism: post-settlement price curve on all 1,112 walk-forward-rule fires 2023-2026: the bottom sits at S+60, -104.1 bp all-era / -127.3 bp 2025-26 vs S+1. Controls: the same names same-day at S-8h are dead (-7.4 bp, t -0.5) and S-4h is +50.5 (t 4.1) - the edge concentrates at the settlement, it is not a generic down-day.
read_this_before_citing_a_number.the_backtest: every fire priced at the registered rule's own book weight that day, entry S-10 open, cover S+60 open, 1m klines: clean net +95.2 mean / +49.9 median / p10 -162.9 / p90 +423.5 per event. Book-weighted overlay +6.13 bp/day over the 1,094-day record (524 fire days), overlay Sharpe 4.3. Klines are a bound, not fills.
read_this_before_citing_a_number.the_premature_tail: the 18 REAL walk-forward premature fires (the rule fired, the print stayed deep) were priced individually: short mean -96.0 gross, median -17.1, worst -944.7 (SOMIUSDT 2025-10-01, a +9.4% squeeze into settlement while the short also pays the deep print). Charged at the measured 18/230 fire-day rate throughout: real_net = (212/230) x clean + (18/230) x (-111.5).
read_this_before_citing_a_number.era_shape: overlay by year: 2023 +0.24, 2024 -0.80 (the honest losing year), 2025 +7.80, 2026 +18.15 bp/day. 2021-24 contributes ~0 by construction of the edge. This is a regime trade on the modern farmer crowd; expect zero-to-slightly-negative outside squeeze regimes while still paying fees.
read_this_before_citing_a_number.the_stop_sweep: every strategy-level stop LOSES against the time-boxed cover, measured on 1m wicks (highs, not opens) for all 1,130 event windows: +300bp whipsaws 12.9% of clean events (overlay 6.13 -> 3.94), +150bp whipsaws 31.2% (median collapses to +1.2), +1000bp still whipsaws 1.5% and costs 0.37 bp/day while doing nothing for the worst observed event (SOMI peaked +940bp, under it). The registered stop is therefore a 0.35 disaster fence, identical in role to carry's declared stop: the cover clock is the exit.
read_this_before_citing_a_number.entry_and_cover_are_frozen_from_measurem: entry at the fire (the pre-settle window, S-15..S-1; the backtest anchor S-10 sits inside it), engine entry window closes at S+5 via book validity - later fills forfeit most of the remaining ride against a full round trip. Cover at S+60 is the measured bottom of the post-settlement curve.
read_this_before_citing_a_number.what_is_NOT_modelled: slippage beyond the taker fee on both legs (shorting into a falling tape may fill better, covering into it worse), partial fills, the engine's flat-first serialization delay after carry's exit (seconds), venue outage during the 75-minute hold.

trigger.note: the carry producer's v7 pre-settle exit fire on a name the carry book holds. No independent detection: if carry does not fire, this sleeve does nothing. The carry kill switch (CARRY_EARLY_EXIT) therefore also silences new exodus entries; covers of open records never depend on it.

entry.at: the fire, immediately; the engine crosses
entry.note: validity 20 min past the settlement means the engine's 15-min entry cutoff closes entries at S+5. rest_entries is OFF for this sleeve: the entry is urgent and the measured economics already pay the taker fee.

cover.note: time-boxed, never price-boxed. The name simply leaves the book; the engine reads absence as the exit and crosses. Covers ride the producer's 60s idle-floor contract with the deadline slot as an accelerator.

sizing.note: the short copies the exact carry-attributed venue quantity from the fresh engine reading at the fire. Audit notional is frozen from that quantity and the fire's Bybit mark price; signed target quantity remains authoritative, so partial fills and later price movement do not resize it. No entry without both live owner-health and mark reads. The backtest was priced at these same positions.

stop.role: disaster fence only, never a strategy exit - see the stop sweep above. The engine requires a stop for admissibility and charges the envelope at 0.35 regardless (DISASTER_STOP_FRACTION), so a tighter number buys no capital back and measurably loses money.

cost_model.charging: 15.56 bp round trip per event in the backtest, plus funding paid by the short through the settlement (max(0, -print), ~0 on clean fires by construction, the full deep print on premature fires)

scoring_recipe.metric: net bp per event and the book-weighted daily overlay, from the engine's own fills (the WAL fills report already attributes per sleeve)
scoring_recipe.comparator: zero, and the no-exodus book (the same days without the overlay)
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only fires strictly after the registration commit count as forward evidence; the sleeve's demo fills are execution evidence, not alpha evidence, until the fill-vs-kline gap is measured
scoring_recipe.cadence: per fire, reviewed weekly for the first month
scoring_recipe.reproduce_with: scratch exodus_short_backtest.py + exodus_stop_sweep.py (session 2026-08-20); the event set is every fire of the registered presettle rule on the panel

measured_at_registration.curve: v6 render 22.87x -> v7 estimate 25.65x -> v7+exodus estimate 50.35x on the same 1,094 days
measured_at_registration.provenance: all numbers are seen-data selection (Lane-1); the walk-forward that produced the fire population is the v7 entry/exit timing program (2026-08-19). Forward evidence starts at this commit.

known_weaknesses: regime concentration: the whole edge is 2025-26; 2024 is negative and 2021-23 flat. If the farmer crowd thins this pays fees for nothing, and nothing in the rule detects that - the kill decision is the owner's, informed by the weekly fire review

the premature tail is fat and real: 7.8% of fire-days, mean -111.5 bp, worst -945, and the measured answer to it is size, NOT a stop - a stop was tested at eight levels and always lost more on clean-event whipsaw than it saved on the tail, and there is no account-level loss control underneath: nothing bounds a run of these
no fill model: entries and covers are priced at 1m kline opens; the first live weeks exist precisely to measure that gap before any capital decision
the all-name generalization (shorting settlement deaths the carry book never held) is measured-but-unrun as an opportunity scan and is NOT part of this config
the trigger inherits every v7 weakness, including the ~55s rate-lock assumption and the ticker read's fail-open; a silent v7 regression silently halves this sleeve too

one-way venue mode: the short cannot open until carry's exit fill lands (the engine leaves foreign names alone); the measured entry anchor tolerates this seconds-scale delay, but a stuck carry exit forfeits the event
